offering_description.value: Owns and operates regulated water and wastewater systems. Collects, treats and distributes potable water to residential, commercial, industrial and fire protection customers, and provides wastewater collection and treatment, mainly in New Jersey and Delaware. Also operates and maintains water and wastewater systems under contract for municipalities.

primary_products.value: treated potable water; fire protection water supply; bulk water supply

primary_services.value: water distribution; wastewater collection and treatment; contract operations and maintenance of water and wastewater systems; utility billing services

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential households receiving water and wastewater service; B2B: commercial and industrial customers, other water utilities buying bulk water; B2G: municipalities for fire protection and contract operations

end_markets.value: residential water supply; commercial and industrial water supply; municipal water and wastewater; fire protection

revenue_model.value: service fees: regulated metered water and wastewater rates charged to customers; project or contract: municipal contract operations and maintenance fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs wells, treatment plants, pipelines and wastewater systems, serving retail customers and utilities

geography_served.value: US regional: New Jersey and Delaware, with some Pennsylvania operations

specialization.value: related lines: water utility, wastewater utility and contract operations

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct pipeline delivery and billing to retail customers and wholesale utilities

regulatory_exposure.value: high: rates set by NJ BPU and Delaware PSC, subject to EPA and state drinking water and environmental rules
